messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Spanish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Spanish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word/Phrase (Spanish) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|----------------------------|--------| | **A** | preposition marking the dative (“to”) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | **te** | 2nd‑person singular pronoun, object of the obligation | **Te** | “you” (object) | OK | | **convien** | impersonal verb meaning “it is obligatory / it behoves” | **conviene** | “it behooves / it is proper” | OK | | **tenere** | infinitive “to hold / to undertake” | **tomar** | “to take / to undertake” | OK | | **altro** | adjective “another, different” | **otro** | “another” | OK | | **vïaggio** | noun “journey, course” | **camino** | “road, path, course” | OK | | **rispuose** | past‑tense verb “he replied” | **respondió** | “he replied” | OK | | **poi** | temporal adverb “after, when” (part of “poi che”) | **cuando** | “when” | OK | | **che** | subordinating conjunction “that” (introducing the clause “that I was weeping”) | **que** | “that” | OK | | **lagrimar** | infinitive “to weep” | **lloraba** | “was weeping” | OK | | **mi** | 1st‑person singular pronoun “me” (object of “lagrimar”) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | **vide** | past‑tense verb “he saw” | **vio** | “he saw” | OK | | **se** | conditional conjunction “if” | **si** | “if” | OK | | **vuo'** | 2nd‑person singular present of “volere” – “you wish” | **deseas** | “you wish / you desire” | OK | | **campar** | infinitive “to escape, get away” | **escapar** | “to escape” | OK | | **d'esto** | prepositional phrase “from this” (di + esto) | **de este** | “from this” | OK | | **loco** | noun “place, location” | **lugar** | “place” | OK | | **selvaggio** | adjective “savage, wild” | **salvaje** | “savage, wild” | OK |
---
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: **A**, **mi** – these elements are required in the Italian source for grammatical reasons but are not expressed in the Spanish translation. - **MISSING / WRONG / GRAMMAR**: none.
All other source words are correctly rendered in the Spanish translation, preserving the intended meaning and grammatical relations.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Spanish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Spanish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: Te conviene tomar otro camino, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 2: - Original: respondió, cuando vio que lloraba, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 3: - Original: si deseas escapar de este lugar salvaje; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` Te conviene tomar otro camino, respondió, cuando vio que lloraba, si deseas escapar de este lugar salvaje; ```
